intro.heading: Investor Rights & Obligations
intro.subtitle: Per SEBI Investor Charter (October 2021) | AMFI Master Circular | SEBI Master Circular for Mutual Funds
intro.summaryLine: Innovate Securities Pvt. Ltd. | ARN-42505 | Valid Until: 05-Apr-2027
intro.notice: At Innovate Securities Private Limited, we believe every investor deserves to know their rights and understand their responsibilities. This page is prepared in accordance with the SEBI Investor Charter (October 2021), AMFI Master Circular, and applicable SEBI regulations. We are committed to ensuring every client is treated fairly, transparently, and with the highest professional standards.

rights.heading: Part A — Your Rights as an Investor

items.title: Right 1 — Right to Information
items.intro: You have the right to receive complete, accurate, and timely information about:
bullets: All scheme-related documents — SID, SAI, and KIM — before making any investment
The risk profile of every Mutual Fund scheme including the SEBI Riskometer rating
Total Expense Ratio (TER) for both Direct and Regular Plans of every scheme
Exit load structure, lock-in periods, and redemption conditions for every scheme
Past performance of the scheme — though past performance does not guarantee future returns
All fees, commissions, and charges — whether paid by you directly or by the AMC on your behalf
Any material changes to the scheme, fund manager, or AMC that may affect your investment

items.title: Right 2 — Right to Know Commission & Charges
items.intro: You have the right to know every rupee earned by your Mutual Fund Distributor:
bullets: Innovate Securities receives trailing commission from AMCs on your Regular Plan investments as part of the Total Expense Ratio (TER) — this is not an additional charge to you
You can see the exact commission earned by Innovate Securities in your Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) from CAMS / KFintech / MF Central
You can compare expense ratios between Direct Plans and Regular Plans at amfiindia.com at any time
Innovate Securities will disclose commission details at the time of investment upon your request — no questions asked
Innovate Securities does NOT charge any additional fees, transaction charges, or advisory fees directly from you
You always have the right to invest in Direct Plans directly through AMC portals at lower expense ratios

items.title: Right 3 — Right to Choose & Switch
bullets: You have the full right to choose any scheme, AMC, or investment platform without any pressure from Innovate Securities
You can switch your investments to another distributor at any time without any penalty from Innovate Securities
You can redeem your investments partially or fully at any time subject to the scheme’s exit load and lock-in conditions
You can request a change of distributor (ARN transfer) by submitting a written request to the concerned AMC

items.title: Right 4 — Right to Fair Treatment & No Mis-Selling
bullets: You have the right to be protected from mis-selling, misrepresentation, and inappropriate product recommendations
No investment recommendation will be made without first understanding your financial goals, risk appetite, and investment horizon
Innovate Securities will never recommend a product based on commission rates received from AMCs
If any investment is outside your assessed risk profile, you will be informed in writing before the transaction
You will never be pressured, rushed, or intimidated into making any investment decision
Innovate Securities is a SEBI-registered Stock Broker and AMFI-registered Mutual Fund Distributor — and is NOT a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser (RIA)

items.title: Right 5 — Right to Grievance Redressal
items.intro: You have the right to a fair, prompt, and effective grievance redressal at multiple levels:

escalationRows.contact: Contact AMC / RTA Investor Relations directly

items.title: Right 6 — Right to Account Statements & Records
bullets: You will receive a transaction confirmation from the AMC within 2 working days of every transaction
You are entitled to receive a Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) every month if you have had a transaction, and half-yearly if your portfolio is active
Your CAS is available anytime at mfcentral.com, camsonline.com, and mfs.kfintech.com
You can request duplicate statements, account details, or transaction history from the AMC at any time — free of charge

items.title: Right 7 — Right to Data Privacy & Protection
bullets: All personal data collected by Innovate Securities is protected under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDPA 2023)
Your data will never be sold, shared, or rented to any third party for marketing purposes
You have the right to access, correct, and request deletion of your personal data held by Innovate Securities
All transaction and investment data is retained for a minimum of 8 years as required by SEBI and PMLA 2002
Contact our Data Protection / Compliance Officer at Mfinnovate@gmail.com for any data privacy concerns

items.title: Right 8 — Right to Nomination
bullets: You have the right to nominate a family member or person of your choice for all your Mutual Fund folios
You can add, change, or delete a nominee at any time by submitting a nomination form to the AMC
In the event of the investor’s demise, the nominee can claim investments through the AMC up to Rs. 15 Lakhs without legal proceedings (as per applicable AMC / regulatory process)

items.title: Right 9 — Right to Unclaimed Investments
bullets: You can trace lost or inactive investments using the MITRA portal at mitra.amfiindia.com
Unclaimed redemption amounts and dividends can be reclaimed from the AMC at any time — there is no time limit

items.title: Right 10 — Right to Investor Education
bullets: You have the right to access free investor education from AMFI at amfiindia.com and mutualfundssahihai.com
You can access NAV, fund performance, and expense ratios for all schemes free of charge at amfiindia.com
You can verify the ARN and registration of any Mutual Fund Distributor at amfiindia.com

obligations.heading: Part B — Your Obligations as an Investor

items.title: Obligation 1 — Provide Accurate Information
bullets: Provide complete, accurate, and up-to-date personal and financial information at all times
Immediately inform Innovate Securities and the AMC / KRA of any change in name, address, mobile number, email, or bank details
Ensure your KYC is always current — outdated KYC can result in transactions being rejected
Never provide false or misleading information — this constitutes a regulatory violation

items.title: Obligation 2 — Complete KYC Before Investing
bullets: KYC is mandatory for all investors before making any Mutual Fund investment
Ensure your KYC is registered with a SEBI-registered KRA (CAMS KRA, CVL KRA, CKYC India, or NDML KRA)
NRI investors must complete FATCA/CRS declarations and provide required documentation

items.title: Obligation 3 — Read All Scheme Documents
bullets: Read the Key Information Memorandum (KIM) before investing in any new scheme
Understand the SEBI Riskometer for every scheme — do not invest in a risk category that does not match your profile
Review the exit load structure — especially for ELSS (3-year lock-in) and close-ended schemes
Do not invest based solely on past performance — past performance does not guarantee future returns

items.title: Obligation 4 — Maintain Confidentiality
bullets: Never share your folio number, transaction PIN, OTP, or login credentials with anyone — including Innovate Securities staff
Innovate Securities will never ask for your password, PIN, or OTP — report immediately if anyone does
Be vigilant of phishing emails, fake portals, and fraudulent calls claiming to be from AMCs or SEBI
Never sign blank application forms, pre-signed authority letters, or blank transaction slips

items.title: Obligation 5 — Maintain Realistic Expectations
bullets: Understand that Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks — there are no guaranteed returns
Never invest borrowed money in equity Mutual Funds
Maintain a long-term perspective — avoid panic redemptions during market corrections
Review your portfolio periodically with Innovate Securities and rebalance based on your changing goals

items.title: Obligation 6 — Comply with Tax Obligations
bullets: Report all Mutual Fund gains accurately in your Income Tax Return (ITR)
ELSS investments qualify for deduction under Section 80C up to Rs. 1.5 Lakhs per annum (as per applicable tax law)
Tax laws are subject to change — consult a qualified tax advisor for specific tax advice

dos.heading: DO’s — Best Practices
items: Read SID / SAI / KIM before every investment
Complete KYC before any transaction
Verify distributor ARN at amfiindia.com
Check your CAS every month for accuracy
Nominate a family member for all folios
Keep contact details updated with AMC / KRA
Invest with a defined goal and time horizon
Use SEBI SCORES for unresolved complaints
Monitor your portfolio periodically
Ask for commission disclosure before investing
Use MITRA portal to trace lost investments
Keep copies of all transaction confirmations

donts.heading: DON’Ts — Avoid These
items: Don’t invest based on tips or social media posts
Don’t share your OTP, PIN, or password with anyone
Don’t sign blank application or authorisation forms
Don’t invest borrowed money in equity funds
Don’t panic-redeem during market corrections
Don’t invest without understanding the risk level
Don’t trust unsolicited calls promising high returns
Don’t delay KYC update — it can freeze your account
Don’t ignore emails or SMS from AMC about your folio
Don’t invest more than your risk appetite allows
Don’t fall for schemes promising guaranteed returns
Don’t deal with unregistered intermediaries
